about: Heartbeat TV channels - one list for the TV page (/tv/), the phone's HB TV app, and the Homes TV. 'page' channels show a site page; 'playlist' channels play approved items from Supabase tv_items for that channel, in order, looping. Users submit to playlist channels; Jaron approves before anything airs (2026-09-26).
